### Proposed Clinical Change
Detailed summary of the requested feature or workflow adjustment.

### Clinical Rationale
Why is this change necessary for patient care, scheduling efficiency, or regulatory compliance?

### Impact Assessment
- [ ] Database Schema / Migrations affected
- [ ] Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) affected
- [ ] Patient Consent Directives affected
- [ ] FHIR Interoperability affected
- [ ] Billing / Financial rules affected

### Safety & Risk Controls
How will unintended cross-patient access or race conditions be prevented?
